supplied_value.meaning: ETH/token value supplied by the caller to execute or pull*

consumed_value.meaning: value actually consumed by the multicall batch

residual_balance.meaning: ETH/token balance left parked on the router after the call

pull_transferred.meaning: tokens transferred from caller to router up front by pull*

execute_forwards_value.meaning: execute forwards msg.value into a delegatecall to Multicall3.

assumptions: execute forwards msg.value into the delegatecall to Multicall3
pull* transfers tokens from the caller to the router before the multicall

unresolved.description: Report does not define a numeric relation between supplied_value and consumed_value beyond the qualitative overfunding statement; the conservation relation is expressed as supplied_value > consumed_value with residual_balance == 0.

limitations: Only the direct residual-balance impact i_residual_remains is formalized; i_expropriation and i_exposure are deferred to future claims.
The report does not specify whether pull* functions also forward ETH or only tokens; the plan treats pull_transferred as a token amount in wei-equivalent units.
The specific public draining vectors referenced in the report are not identified and are not part of this core relation.
The overfunding scenario is conditional; the report does not state whether it was observed in a real transaction.
